A new update has been applied on August 21st.

notes.title: Update & Bug Fixes 0717 (Additional)
notes.content:
Update[olist]
Stage 2-1 has been added.
- You can proceed to it after clearing Stage 1-6.


New items have been added.
- 4 Common, 4 Rare, and 9 Legendary items.


Mission progress UI has been updated.
- The mission UI, which was previously displayed on the ground in front of the crystal, has been     moved to the top center of the screen.


The difficulty of Stage 1-1 has been slightly reduced.


Sound effects of some bug monsters have been updated.


EXP gained from all stages has been increased by 30%.
[/olist]


Bug Fixes[olist]
Fixed an issue where players did not receive additional skill points when re-clearing previously completed stages with a higher score.
(e.g., clearing Stage 1-5 with 1 star would grant 1 skill point, but clearing it again later with 3 stars should grant 2 additional skill points—this was not working previously.)


Fixed untranslated words or descriptions in some areas.


Fixed an issue where the Drummer would not move when in front of a barricade.


Issue where stats were not applied correctly when equipping or unequipping items.



[/olist]
To address the issue where some players did not receive the correct amount of skill points, all skill points have been reset and redistributed accordingly.

I always welcome your feedback.

Thank you!

notes.title: Demo Update 0513 (+Added)
notes.content:
Update

1. Fusion Chamber Added

The Fusion Chamber has been added.
It becomes available starting from Stage 3, and can also be used in Stages 1 and 2 after completing the tutorial.
The Fusion Chamber allows you to fuse two identical units to enhance their stats.
(Units that require plasma energy or have already been fused cannot be used.)

Stat increases from fusion are as follows:

- Attack and Energy Attack: +50%

- Defense and Energy Defense: +1

- Health: +50%

- Health Regeneration: +1

- Attack Speed and Accuracy: +20%

Try using the Fusion Chamber to create powerful combinations!

2. Reduced Skill Point Requirement for Basic Units
The number of skill points required to learn skills for basic units has been reduced.

Bug Fixes

1.  Fixed an issue where the tutorial would repeat even after completion.

2.  Fixed an issue where some character stats were displayed incorrectly.

3.  Fixed an issue where some flying units had no effects upon death.

4. Fixed an issue where Vant’s wall health increase skill was not applied.

notes.title: Gameplay Improvements and Updates
notes.content:
Hello,

The previous gameplay system of "Summoning a Channel before Summoning Units" has been simplified to "Selecting a Channel before Summoning Units."

The "Channel" system has been removed, and now you can choose your desired faction directly from the Unit Transporter to summon units.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119458/af5b3350536f4778480fd005aa9bde8d611691ef.png


Update

1. Lady Ant Skill Changes

2. Tutorial Adjustments

3. Unit Health and Defense Stat Adjustments

Thank you!

notes.title: Demo Play Available from Friday!
notes.content:
Hello!

After numerous updates, I am finally reopening the demo on March 14 (Friday, 5–6 PM KST)!
(The demo version is the same as the prologue version.)


Updates

[olist]
 New Item Grades & Effects

Items are now classified into Normal, Rare, and Legendary grades.
Rare and Legendary items come with additional abilities or effects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119458/4b052b25cd0cf19c2588b96b34d0f43696265497.png

 New Skills & Skill Point Adjustments

New skills have been added and some existing ones have been changed.
The skill point requirement for unlocking skills has been reduced.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119458/9876e96a6c8fefa955e7ceb882f995a327f668c3.png

 New Perks & Mutations Added

 Character Design Updates

 Game System Changes

Upgrade structures are no longer summoned during gameplay. Instead, they will now be pre-summoned at the start of the game.
[/olist]
I hope many of you will try it out, and I always welcome your feedback! 🚀

notes.title: New Stage Update!!
notes.content:
Stage 1-4 of the demo version has been updated!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119458/28b9ac3c4c63c9a5e2669f64a4b924700f829841.png

Defend the crystal to the end against new and even more powerful enemies!!


1. Stage 1-1 Update


 Increased starting crystal energy at the beginning of the game.
 Increased bug spawn frequency.
 Reduced mission duration.


2. Stage 1-2 Update


 Changed the summoned structures at the start of the game.

We've added arrows to show where the enemies will come from before the mission starts. The arrows will disappear once the mission begins.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119458/bfc3e44e4854db7e35f023edb2e3f5f96ef21ca3.png

Bug Fixes


 Fixed an issue where some words did not change when switching languages on the main screen and then moving to the character window.
 Fixed an issue where it was impossible to switch from the story to the stats window when moving from the character window to the main screen and back to the character window.
 Fixed an issue where the icon size was abnormal when skipping the score screen after completing a mission.


I look forward to your feedback to help make a better game.

Thank you!!
